evidence_update.trigger: The predeclared CL observer produced its first post-review long onsets and now has five exact eligible onsets covering both configured directions.
evidence_update.prior_assessment: CL was the highest-priority fourth-slot research track pending a new long onset and exact prospective evidence.
evidence_update.updated_assessment: The frozen CL breakout-pressure identity is rejected as the fourth-slot mechanism because all three resolved 15-minute long paths are negative and the combined sample is negative at every measured horizon after modeled friction.

hypothesis.claim: MU remains the stronger single semiconductor research candidate, while the fourth non-crypto slot remains open after the current CL breakout-pressure mechanism failed prospective fixed-horizon evidence.

cl_prospective_result.reason: Every observed long path is negative at 15 minutes, all resolved long paths remain negative at 60 and 240 minutes, every combined horizon is negative, and winner removal worsens the result. The small sample does not prove CL is intrinsically untradeable; it falsifies this frozen mechanism as the preferred fourth-slot route.
cl_prospective_result.falsifier: Reopen CL only under a separately predeclared mechanism or materially different causal regime hypothesis with new prospective evidence, exact source parity, realistic costs, and positive both-side robustness after winner removal. Do not reuse these rows for selection and confirmation.

semiconductor_decision.basis: MU retains eight prospective onsets and positive 15-minute and 60-minute two-largest-winner markout sensitivity. SKHX still has only one prospective all-long onset. Neither is live-ready.
semiconductor_decision.minimum_update_evidence: Reassess MU at 20 independent paths or the first short-side onset; reconsider SKHX only after a predeclared both-side window with resolved route-native evidence.

proposal_contract.recommendation: Do not add CL, MU, or SKHX to the live roster now. Keep MU report-only, leave SKHX deferred, and keep the fourth non-crypto slot open rather than replacing one rejected mechanism with another unvalidated route.
proposal_contract.why_now: The predeclared CL evidence trigger has occurred and contradicted the post-hoc long-side development lead. The current v51 index routes have higher decision value because they are already executable and still lack adequate both-side lifecycle evidence.
proposal_contract.evidence_reviewed: Exact CL prospective decision journal and L2 book prefix, immutable causal BBO markout report, prior four-plus-four revision, MU markout revision, and SKHX forward revision.
proposal_contract.observed_problem_or_opportunity: CL supplied industry diversification but not a robust breakout-pressure edge. The portfolio still needs a fourth non-crypto mechanism, but forcing an asset into the slot would substitute breadth for expectancy.
proposal_contract.applicable_market_regime: The rejection applies only to the frozen 15-minute breakout-pressure identity and its observed prospective episodes. It does not generalize to every possible CL strategy or oil regime.
proposal_contract.alternatives_considered: Continue CL unchanged, select CL long-only, revive SILVER, use both semiconductor names, revive rejected GOLD/BRENTOIL mechanisms, or leave the slot open. The first five reuse adverse or selected evidence; leaving it open is the only evidence-consistent baseline.
proposal_contract.expected_upside: Avoids allocating live capital to a prospectively negative mechanism while preserving an active search for a genuinely diversifying route.
proposal_contract.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Small CL sample, fixed-horizon markouts rather than full fills, one 60-minute and two 240-minute exit gaps, regime dependence, and the risk of prematurely rejecting an asset rather than the tested mechanism.
proposal_contract.validation_completed: Five exact eligible CL onsets were matched at entry; all five resolved at 15 minutes, four at 60 minutes, and three at 240 minutes. Both sides are represented, costs are modeled from frozen fee and latency evidence, and every combined horizon plus winner-removal sensitivity is negative.
proposal_contract.validation_still_required: A future CL mechanism would require a new predeclared causal hypothesis, route-native stop/exit lifecycle replay, exact funding and depth-sized friction, roll/session analysis, source parity, and untouched forward confirmation. MU and the live index routes retain their existing evidence requirements.
proposal_contract.success_metrics: Any future fourth-slot route must be positive after realistic costs and largest-winner removal, cover both sides and non-adjacent episodes, resolve source and lifecycle gaps, and improve portfolio behavior rather than merely lower asset-price correlation.
proposal_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: No rollback is needed because no live change occurred. Reopen the current CL identity only if its immutable evidence is disproven; otherwise require a distinct new mechanism and untouched data.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Capture the first attributable eligible and fully resolved SP500 long lifecycle under the unchanged v51 contract while resolving the open SPCX short; continue MU report-only until 20 independent paths or its first short onset.
limitations: No asset, strategy, route, side, sizing, leverage, stop, exit, execution, or deployment setting changed.
Fixed-horizon BBO markouts are diagnostics rather than realized route PnL.
The CL sample is adequate to reject the current mechanism priority but not to conclude that no CL strategy can work.
The fourth non-crypto slot remains intentionally unfilled until evidence supports an approval-ready proposal.
